prompt: A flat graphic seen straight on: a line of small round buoys connected by a single white line, running from left to right across the upper two thirds and stepping up and down like a sequence of steps in a process, white line on medium cerulean blue, the lower third left clean, flat and empty. Richly detailed engraved antique nautical chart style, like a fine sea chart printed in two inks: many layers of fine lines and hatching in the cerulean field, line density increasing in the darker areas to give depth and tone, lines of several weights, crisp and sharp, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. Flat graphic, no horizon, no sky, no landscape, no photographic rendering, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border, no frame. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd and ink grey #13212b.
